featured_reviews.name: Rylan Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been going to Golds Gym Bandra for many years since it opened, but only while visiting from the US. Initially I used to use the Golds gym “passport” but later started paying for 2 weeks at a time. I am used to it, so I kept coming back. I work out wherever I go in the world, and one of my favorite things to do when traveling is to try out the gym - whether it is a local gym or a hotel gym or a friends gym or a cruise ship gym. I’ve worked out in Sydney, Dubai, all over the US, in big cities and small towns, couple of gyms in Mumbai back in the day, many, many hotel gyms. So I’ve seen a fair bit of different gyms.

Let’s keep this simple and objective:

Pros
- Has all the strength training equipment you’d need for any body part
- Very helpful, friendly floor trainers for when you need a spot
- Ladies walking around with spray bottles who clean equipment off on request
- Very close to my mom’s place (where I grew up), just basically around the block, so very convenient for me
- People have good vibes - everyone is there to work out, not clown around. People do not hog machines. It is very acceptable to ask someone to rotate with you. In some gyms in other countries people want to plant themselves on a machine for 10-20-30 minutes, and think you are rude if you ask to work in with them (I’m just going 3 more sets!),
- 6 am to 12 midnight on weekdays, so not quite 24x7 but good number of hours

Cons
- Equipment, for the most part is the same stuff they opened with in 2003. This includes not just their machines, but their sound equipment. There are a couple of new things, but not that much.
- Speaking of sound equipment, they have some random music playing each time I visit. Sometimes it’s rap, sometimes club, sometimes goodness knows what. And it is always very loud.
- Lots. Of. People. It is very crowded, all the time. And either their A/C does not work, or it is so crowded all you feel is sweaty body heat from everyone. Luckily, because members are SO good about rotating between sets, you can use any machine you want with only a 30 second wait usually. What this means is you also need to be comfortable with rotating with other people. You can’t just leave your stuff on a bench and go chat with someone.
- Very few cardio machines, and it is too hot to run anyway.

As a bonus, here are some interesting stats.
- One gym I go to in Wisconsin is about 40x as big as Golds gym. Hard to believe, but it’s true. Also since there are so many people there, and they DONT rotate machines like at Golds gym, I prefer Golds gym.
- One gym I go to is about 2-3 times as big as Golds gym. But there are not many people there at any point in time. That’s my favorite place to work out, because I can get a good solid work out in and it is quiet and pretty empty all the time.  They also got all new equipment recently.

Anyway, the moral of the story is -
Golds Gym Bandra is a decent gym for serious weight training, with aging yet adequate equipment, and excellent floor trainers. It is always stuffy and crowded, but members make up for this with good gym etiquette, freely letting other members rotate within sets. While there are way bigger and better gyms around the world, with more modern equipment, it does not necessarily mean you will enjoy your workout more elsewhere!

I have been told that some special discount offer are going on hence I should pay the fee then and can join the gym later on as per my convenience. He has told me that he is calling me just for assessment, then I can join the gym anytime as per my convenience. I have visited and met Mr. Christie. However, it became clear that the sessions I was told for assessment by Mr. Christie were actually conducted to convince me to opt for personal training. I cannot afford the personal training offer of Mr. Christie. After that I tried to continue the gym session and visited gym 3-4 times, however, due to aforementioned office commitments and my health issues I could not visit the gym till date.

I have paid the six months’ fee in the month of June. I have called the gym at least four or five times to request this. Each time I was told it would be done and that a senior member would confirm it with me. However, I am still waiting for a call from the gym. I humbly request you to please look in to the matter and help me in this regard. I belong to middle class family and have paid the fees from my hard-earned money.

On the basis of my experience of 3-4 work outs in the gym I have noticed some other issues also. At the time of paying the fee I was told about some complementary cult elite, however, during my gym visit it was not activated and even my membership card mentioning my gym workout plans and schedules of fitness first have not been issued to me. Before paying the gym fees, I expressed my biggest fear, concern, and doubt regarding large gyms like yours—that such gyms only promote personal training. For people like me, who cannot afford expensive personal training, these gyms are of no use. No one informs us about what exercises to do, what the schedule should be, or how to use the machines and equipment. If no one guides us, what is the point of coming to the gym? When you ask the trainers, most of them are personal trainers, and the others simply avoid us and disappear. You end up frustrated, just standing around. featured_reviews.name: Jasmine K
featured_reviews.review_text:
What a wild 8-month fitness journey in Bombay!

I signed up for the 72 + 1 free class package at Flofit while I was in India — honestly thinking I’d never finish it. I walked in with a bunch of health issues and zero energy, plus those chaotic Bombay monsoons made getting to the gym feel like a mini survival challenge 😂. I cancelled so many times in the beginning… but slowly, I found my rhythm, pushed through, and I actually completed the entire package! 🙌

Flofit is such a vibe — great music, solid energy, and all the latest equipment. Big thanks to Wasim, who convinced me to take the plunge and always greets everyone with that trademark smile. And Shrutika, who’s the sweetest and never misses saying hi and bye.

My biggest shoutout goes to Sujit, my trainer — truly the best. Kind, funny, and incredibly patient. He’s super attentive and really focuses on mobility, stretches, and form. I always looked forward to my PT sessions with him — we had great chats and lots of laughs. I’m going to miss him the most. Highly recommend Sujit if you’re looking for a top-notch coach!

Special mention to Mahesh and the entire Flofit crew — sorry if I’ve missed a few names, you guys are all awesome.

Now that I’m heading back to Singapore, I can proudly say I feel stronger, healthier, and more alert. All my health markers are down — mission accomplished 💪

featured_reviews.name: Tom Noonan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been going to FloFitBox for four months now and am really enjoying it. The coach leading the evening sessions, Sunny, is a fantastic trainer and is always attentive, encouraging, and really enthusiastic. The programming is excellent and very structured, building strength, developing movements, and improving overall fitness over 6-week blocs, which makes it easier to plan your sessions. The programming is balanced enough that you can go every day if you want, and still benefit. From Monday to Friday here are six classes from 6am to noon, and another four from 5pm to 8pm in the  evening, so the schedule is really flexible and you can go to any class that suits. The gym is also open for solo workouts or personal training at the weekend.

The only thing I would change is to recommend purchasing air purifiers for the gym space, to protect clients' and staff members' health once monsoon ends. I think this was considered before and it would be a good investment.

featured_reviews.name: Karan Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: FloFit has been a game-changer for me, and a big part of that is thanks to Coach Sunny. He introduced me to some new mobility drills that I hadn’t tried before, and the difference has been incredible. My range of motion has improved, lifts feel smoother, and recovery is quicker. It’s rare to find coaches who pay attention to the small details that make a big impact — Sunny does just that. Highly recommend this place to anyone serious about levelling up their training.

featured_reviews.name: Genesia Alves
featured_reviews.review_text: The group classes are the best workouts in the city. The Flofit Blueprint is created by a master trainer who knows his stuff. The trainers are just brilliant - they watch your form, constantly upgrade your skills in the most intuitive way, they push you and they help you up your game. It’s a friendly, encouraging space and the results just rack up because it’s easy to be consistent when you look forward to showing up.

featured_reviews.name: Roopa Bansal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was visiting Bandra for a few weeks and was staying near this gym. The gym is clean and has a great range of workout machines and weights.

I used their personal training services and the coach assigned to me was Leeladhar. He is very knowledgeable and a fantastic coach. I explained my problem areas and my goals. He made sure to customize my training routine that supported my goals. He even built a plan for me when I left so I could continue my fitness journey. Thank you LD!

If you are looking for a qualified personal trainer then I highly recommend Leeladhar.

featured_reviews.name: Himanshu Mody
featured_reviews.review_text: Being a member at FloFitBox has been an absolute game-changer for me! The atmosphere is incredibly welcoming, and the staff are always friendly and supportive. The variety of classes they offer keeps me motivated and excited to come back for more. The facilities are top-notch and always clean. Plus, the sense of community here is unmatched – I’ve made so many friends who share my passion for fitness. If you’re looking for a place to achieve your fitness goals while having fun, FloFitBox is the place to be!

featured_reviews.name: Rachel Burchett
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank goodness for FloFitBox! After a year of being inside and doing home workouts, we’ve found a safe, fun and professional community to workout with. The coaches will make you work hard, and the results speak for themselves. Full warm up & warm down, and challenging workouts that can be scaled depending on your skills and level of fitness. The different workout spaces mean we work out safely, with physical distance, and the spaces are sanitised between each class. I’ve been a member of many different boxes around the world, and FloFitBox tops them all. Coaches are excellent, communication is great, pricing is great, and there is a real sense of community. Can’t recommend them highly enough.

2. Management - Management team of the gym is very ineffective and not that strong. We all work for money but a Gym is a holy place for many peoples and it should be handled like a School or College wherein there should be strict discipline and code of conduct which isn’t thing taken seriously in the gym. Members come here to Socialize, hog machines, not keeping dumbbells' / weights / rods in designated place after use, no social sense of presence of other peoples around, wearing headphones and talking loudly, banging weights, etc. I have been to local gyms where though machinery is average and not that high profile, but at least management is strong enough to instill discipline in members.

3. Timings - Gym is operational till 10:30, however most of the good and high profile gyms in our area are open till 11:00 p.m. Gym can be kept open till 11:00 p.m. very effectively without any hesitation.

4. Availability of Steam - Steam is available only on Wednesday’s and Saturday’s which was informed when joined. However sometimes steam is abruptly closed or not available on designated days without any prior notice and just putting up a piece of paper as government circular on notice board on same day.

5. Gym closed on public holidays and Sundays - Gym is closed on many of the public holidays on top of being closed on Sundays. Most of the gyms in Mumbai are either open full day on Sundays or at least for half day till noon. I agree that holidays are part and parcel of every job, but being a cult gym other cult gyms around our areas are open on public holidays and Sundays too.

Conclusion:
I have just joined this gym due to availability of good machinery, fame of Cult and proximity near my residence, however after paying a good hefty yearly fees, overall ambience, vibes and mood is like any other local AC gym in any good area. So think before joining gym just based on exterior appearance and name.
